messages:
Nora (Release Lead): Sprint-182 release train launching. Freeze begins Wed 23:00 UTC. Post-freeze only P0/P1 hotfixes + security fixes.
Nora (Release Lead): Deployment timeline: Thu 07:30 UTC canary-1 (5%), Thu 08:15 canary-2 (20%), Thu 09:30 gradual ramp to 100% with automatic pause points at 30% and 60% for health checks.
Mei (Platform): Note: planned maintenance on infra Thu 03:00-04:00 UTC (network firmware). Expect brief pod restarts; avoid heavy jobs then.
Maya (SRE): Pre-deploy gates: CI green, smoke tests pass, no SLO regressions in last 12h, perf p95 < 115ms on staging.
Carlos (PM): Quick Q — do we need a customer-facing blurb for Console and API docs? I can draft one.
Nora (Release Lead): Yes please. Carlos, drop draft in #marketing or DM me. We’ll include it in release notes.
Jesse (Devex): Changelog reminder: add a 1-2 line public note in /docs/releases/notes.md and mention rollback steps. Small PRs speed reviews.
Nora (Release Lead): Feature flags rule: every user-visible change must be behind a flag and default off for canary. Add flag name to PR description.
Mei (Platform): Autoscaler watch: I’ll post CPU/mem snapshots at 25/50/75% ramp points.
Maya (SRE): Approvals: any cherry-pick needs approvals from Nora + Maya. Use label release/cherry and link CI.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by nora/release-train at 2026-03-28T07:30:00Z. Jobs: build, unit-tests, smoke.
deploy-bot: build succeeded (job 4497).
deploy-bot: unit-tests failed (job 4498) — failing test: runtime/cache/kv_expiry_test.
Nora (Release Lead): @eng-oncall please triage failing test, tagging me when fixed.
Maya (SRE): Investigating flaky test. Restarted job 4499.
deploy-bot: unit-tests succeeded (job 4499).
Nora (Release Lead): Go/no-go check at Thu 07:00 UTC. Post any last minute blockers here.
Carlos (PM): Customer blurb ready, posting in #marketing and attaching to release PR.
Jesse (Devex): Tiny note: if you change generation models, include a 10-example prompt set in PR so Optimize can run quick checks.
Mei (Platform): All set on infra side. Will watch network and post anomalies.
Maya (SRE): I will push health dashboards after each canary to this thread. :white_check_mark: 
Nora (Release Lead): Thanks team. Remember: no destructive DB migrations during freeze. If you have one, open RFC to postpone.
deploy-bot: integration-tests queued (job 4501).
Nora (Release Lead): Final: freeze starts Wed 23:00 UTC. See runbook: <https://confluence/redwood/releases/sprint-182-runbook|sprint-182-runbook>.
